predecessors.name: Zulu Kingdom
predecessors.text: the north-west of Zululand around Vryheid, the capital; the 66 km radius reproduces the page's 13,600 km2 (the same region the Zululand dossier uses for its 1884 loss)

successors.name: South African Republic (Transvaal)
successors.text: the north-west of Zululand around Vryheid, the capital; the 66 km radius reproduces the page's 13,600 km2 (the same region the Zululand dossier uses for its 1884 loss)

ledger.x: 1884: the Boers form the Nieuwe Republiek at Vryheid.
20 July 1888: the New Republic joins the Transvaal.

wars.name: Zulu civil war of 1884 (Tshaneni)
wars.outcome: Dinuzulu and the Boers defeated Zibhebhu at Tshaneni on 5 June 1884; two months later the Boers formed the Nieuwe Republiek on the land Dinuzulu granted them.

certainty.note: The boundary is a grant of 1,355,000 morgen allotted by lottery in farms of 1,000-3,000 morgen; the page gives no boundary line, and the extension to the coast was never settled before Britain annexed it in 1887.
